name: Lyons Corporate Market Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Lyons Corporate 
Market Ltd provides loans and invests in shares and securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
LCML functions as a Non-Systemically Important, Non-Deposit, Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC). Its operations are confined to India, primarily focusing on providing loans and making investments in shares and securities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.97 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.17% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.64 Cr.
